Script.name: loottracker/db
Script.script:
--[[ Loot Tracker — schema Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
The MUSHclient version drove sqlite3 directly. Mudlet's db: layer is the documented way in, so the tables are declared here and every query in init.lua goes through it. Same columns, same keys — a converted SolaoLoot.db drops straight in.
Mudlet writes this to <profile>/Database_aardloot.db. ]]
aard = aard or {} aard.loot = aard.loot or {}
local LT = aard.loot
LT.STAT_COLS = { "str", "intel", "wis", "dex", "con", "luck", "hp", "mana", "moves", "hit", "dam", "all_phys", "all_magic", "acid", "air", "bash", "cold", "disease", "earth", "electric", "energy", "fire", "holy", "light", "magic", "mental", "negative", "pierce", "poison", "shadow", "slash", "sonic", "water", }
local function stats_sheet() local t = { item = "", item_color = "", keywords = "", type = "", level = 0, worth = 0, weight = 0, score = 0, wearable = "", material = "", flags = "", found_at = "", clan_item = "", owned_by = "", leads_to = "", notes = "", weapon_type = "", ave_dam = 0, specials = "", inflicts = "", dam_type = "", spells = "", capacity = 0, full_id = 0, last_id = 0, synced = 0, _index = { "type" }, _unique = { { "item" } }, } for _, c in ipairs(LT.STAT_COLS) do t[c] = 0 end return t end
-- Take the handle db:create hands back rather than assuming db.aardloot exists. -- The first run proved that assumption wrong: the tables and indexes were built -- correctly but db.aardloot was nil, so every consumer read as "not loaded". -- Whatever the reason, the return value is the thing we were actually given. local ok, handle = pcall(db.create, db, "aardloot", { loot = { item = "", item_color = "", mob = "", zone = "", roomid = 0, room = "", count = 1, last_seen = 0, synced = 0, _index = { "item", "mob", "synced" }, _unique = { { "item", "mob" } }, }, shop_stock = { item = "", item_color = "", keeper = "", zone = "", roomid = 0, room = "", price = 0, level = 0, last_seen = 0, synced = 0, _index = { "item", "synced" }, _unique = { { "item", "roomid" } }, }, gathered = { item = "", item_color = "", source = "", zone = "", roomid = 0, room = "", count = 1, last_seen = 0, synced = 0, _index = { "item", "synced" }, _unique = { { "item", "source", "roomid" } }, }, item_stats = stats_sheet(), })
LT.dbh = ok and handle or nil LT.dberr = (not ok) and tostring(handle) or nil
-- Resolved on use, not at load. Grabbing db.aardloot.<sheet> here means one bad -- moment during db:create leaves LT.t nil forever, and every consumer then reads -- as "Loot Tracker isn't loaded" with no way back short of a restart. Going -- through __index makes the lookup retry each time instead. -- resolved on use: prefer the handle we were handed, fall back to the documented -- db.<name> path, and retry on every access rather than caching a nil LT.t = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k) local d = LT.dbh or (db and db.aardloot) return d and d[k] or nil end, })
-- text columns; everything else in item_stats is numeric LT.STAT_TEXT = { item = true, item_color = true, keywords = true, type = true, wearable = true, material = true, flags = true, found_at = true, clan_item = true, owned_by = true, leads_to = true, notes = true, weapon_type = true, specials = true, inflicts = true, dam_type = true, spells = true, }

Script.name: loottracker
Script.script:
--[[ Loot Tracker — port of Solao_Loot_Tracker (MUSHclient) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Every time you loot an item off a corpse it records the item, the mob it came from, and the zone/room you were in (from GMCP). Native shop stock and room resources go in their own tables, and any identify/appraise box that scrolls past is parsed for stats — so a shop appraise fills the DB with no wish and no extra traffic.
Ports of note: - sqlite3 -> Mudlet's db: layer (see db.lua) - MUSHclient's @-coded item colour -> a hex colour read off the line with selectString/getFgColor, which is how Mudlet gets at the same thing - async.doAsyncRemoteRequest -> Mudlet's getHTTP/postHTTP + sys*HttpDone ]]
aard = aard or {} aard.loot = aard.loot or {}
local LT = aard.loot local U = aard.util local T = LT.t
local API_URL = "https://api.aardwolf.muds.fyi"
local CFG = U.load("loottracker", { autoid = false, -- needs the identify wish to return anything useful idnote = true, bags = "bag,backpack,pouch,sack,satchel,purse,quiver,holding,pack,wallet,keyring", flags = table.concat({ "godly", "divine", "mythical", "fabled", "epic", "legendary", "eternal", "exalted", "majestic", "wondrous", "radiant", "brilliant", "dazzling", "shimmering", "gleaming", "sparkling", "vibrant", "shiny", "burnished", "enhanced", "polished", }, ","), authkey = "", authname = "", lastfull = 0, })
local function save() U.save("loottracker", CFG) end
local function csv_set(s) local t = {} for word in (s or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do local w = U.trim(word):lower() if w ~= "" then t[w] = true end end return t end
local function set_csv(t) local a = {} for w in pairs(t) do a[#a + 1] = w end table.sort(a) return table.concat(a, ",") end
local exclude = csv_set(CFG.bags) local bonus_flags = csv_set(CFG.flags)
local my_bags = {} -- shortdesc:lower -> true, learned from invdata (rename-proof) local inv_serial = {} -- shortdesc:lower -> serial
--- -- colour helpers -- -- MUSHclient handed the trigger a styles table. Mudlet gives us the live line, so -- we select the run we care about and read its foreground colour back as hex. ---
local function hex(r, g, b) return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", r or 0, g or 0, b or 0) end
local function color_of(text) if not text or text == "" then return "" end local ok = pcall(selectString, text, 1) if not ok then return "" end local okc, r, g, b = pcall(getFgColor) if not okc or not r then return "" end return hex(r, g, b) end
-- Aardwolf paints the bonus-tier bracket white/yellow/red/green. Close enough by -- channel: the tiers are saturated primaries, nothing subtle. local function bracket_tier(colour) if colour == "" then return nil end local r = tonumber(colour:sub(2, 3), 16) or 0 local g = tonumber(colour:sub(4, 5), 16) or 0 local b = tonumber(colour:sub(6, 7), 16) or 0 if r > 150 and g > 150 and b > 150 then return "W" end if r > 150 and g > 150 and b < 120 then return "Y" end if r > 150 and g < 120 and b < 120 then return "R" end if r < 120 and g > 120 and b < 120 then return "G" end return nil end
--- -- name normalisation -- -- Bonus-loot variants ('help gameload'): a mob-reset item can roll random stats -- and gets a flag welded onto its name — "(Polished) Runed Jade Bracer". The flag -- is a per-kill dice roll, not a different item, so for provenance the base name -- is what we want, or every roll spawns a new row. -- -- Can't just strip any leading (Word): plenty of real names start that way — -- (Seekers) Elixir of Free Movement — and shops sell a (Legendary) Bracers of the -- Warrior-Poet that has nothing to do with the bonus tier. So two signals have to -- agree: the word is a known flag, AND the bracket colour matches its tier. ---
local function base_name(item, tier) item = U.trim(item or "")
-- "2 * the body armor of ..." is the stacked-pickup syntax, never a name item = U.trim((item:gsub("^%d+%s*%*%s*", "")))
-- ((Godly)) is doubled and white-bracketed local word, rest = item:match("^%(%((%a+)%)%)%s*(.*)$") if word and bonus_flags[word:lower()] then if (not tier) or tier == "W" then return U.trim(rest) end return item end
-- every other tier is a single (Word) in yellow, red or green brackets word, rest = item:match("^%((%a+)%)%s*(.*)$") if word and bonus_flags[word:lower()] and rest ~= "" then if (not tier) or tier == "Y" or tier == "R" or tier == "G" then return U.trim(rest) end end return item end
local function is_bag(source) local low = source:lower() for w in pairs(exclude) do if low:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
local function room_now() local num, name, zone = U.room() return zone or "", num or 0, name or "" end
--- -- upsert helpers — db: has no "insert or ignore then bump", so do it by hand ---
local function bump(sheet, keys, fields) local found = db:fetch(sheet, db:AND(unpack(keys))) if found and found[1] then local row = found[1] fields.count = (row.count or 0) + 1 db:update(sheet, fields, db:AND(unpack(keys))) else fields.count = 1 db:add(sheet, fields) end end
--- -- capture ---
function LT.on_loot(item, mob) item, mob = U.trim(item), U.trim(mob) if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then return end -- gold isn't loot if item == "" or mob == "" then return end -- mob short-descs always lead with an article; a player corpse is a bare name. -- No article means PK loot, which we don't record. local low = mob:lower() if not (low:match("^a ") or low:match("^an ") or low:match("^the ")) then return end
local citem = color_of(item) local tier = bracket_tier(color_of(item:match("^(%(+)") or "")) item = base_name(item, tier)
local zone, roomid, room = room_now() bump(T.loot, { db:eq(T.loot.item, item), db:eq(T.loot.mob, mob) }, { item = item, item_color = citem, mob = mob, zone = zone, roomid = roomid, room = room, last_seen = os.time(), synced = 0 })
LT.queue_autoid(item) end
-- native shop stock ('---' Qty). Keyed on (item, roomid) so re-listing updates price. function LT.on_shop(lvl, price, item) item = U.trim(item) if item == "" then return end local citem = color_of(item) local zone, roomid, room = room_now() local keys = { db:eq(T.shop_stock.item, item), db:eq(T.shop_stock.roomid, roomid) } local fields = { item = item, item_color = citem, zone = zone, roomid = roomid, room = room, price = tonumber(price) or 0, level = tonumber(lvl) or 0, last_seen = os.time(), synced = 0, } local found = db:fetch(T.shop_stock, db:AND(unpack(keys))) if found and found[1] then db:update(T.shop_stock, fields, db:AND(unpack(keys))) else db:add(T.shop_stock, fields) end end
local function record_gather(item, citem, source, tier) item = base_name(item, tier) local zone, roomid, room = room_now() bump(T.gathered, { db:eq(T.gathered.item, item), db:eq(T.gathered.source, source), db:eq(T.gathered.roomid, roomid) }, { item = item, item_color = citem, source = source, zone = zone, roomid = roomid, room = room, last_seen = os.time(), synced = 0 }) return roomid, zone, room end
-- room-resource gather: source is a room object (bush, chest, desk), NOT a corpse -- and NOT one of your own containers function LT.on_get(item, source) item, source = U.trim(item), U.trim(source) if item == "" or source == "" then return end if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then return end if source:lower():find("corpse", 1, true) then return end -- on_loot handles those if my_bags[source:lower()] then return end -- a container you carry if is_bag(source) then return end -- word-list fallback local tier = bracket_tier(color_of(item:match("^(%(+)") or "")) record_gather(item, color_of(item), source, tier) end
-- invdata: learn which carried items are containers (type 11), so gets from your -- own bags are skipped no matter what you've renamed them to function LT.on_invitem(payload) local parts = {} for p in (payload .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do parts[#parts + 1] = p end local n = #parts if n < 7 then return end local d = {} for i = 3, n - 5 do d[#d + 1] = parts[i] end -- desc may itself contain commas local desc = U.trim(table.concat(d, ",")) if desc == "" then return end inv_serial[desc:lower()] = U.trim(parts[1]) if tonumber(parts[n - 3]) == 11 then my_bags[desc:lower()] = true end end
--- -- 'loot here': send a get, catch its "You get <item>." so the full name and -- colour get recorded as a floor spawn ---
local here_pending, here_catch_id, here_timer_id = false, nil, nil
local function here_disarm() here_pending = false if here_catch_id then killTrigger(here_catch_id); here_catch_id = nil end if here_timer_id then killTimer(here_timer_id); here_timer_id = nil end end
local function here_arm() here_pending = true here_catch_id = tempRegexTrigger("^You get (.+?)\\.$", function() if not here_pending then return end local item = U.trim(matches[2] or "") if item:find(" from ", 1, true) then return end -- a container get slipped in here_disarm() if item:match("^[%d,]+ gold coins?$") then U.note("Loot Tracker: that was gold, not recorded.") return end local tier = bracket_tier(color_of(item:match("^(%(+)") or "")) local roomid, _, room = record_gather(item, color_of(item), "the ground", tier) U.ok("Recorded '" .. item .. "' on the ground in " .. (room ~= "" and room or "?") .. " (" .. roomid .. ").") end) here_timer_id = tempTimer(3, function() if here_pending then here_disarm() U.warn("Loot Tracker: no pickup seen - is the item here? Nothing recorded.") end end) end
--- -- auto-identify ---
local autoid_q = {}
local function have_full_id(item) local r = db:fetch(T.item_stats, db:eq(T.item_stats.item, item)) return r and r[1] and r[1].full_id == 1 end
function LT.queue_autoid(item) if not CFG.autoid or item == "" then return end if aard.whopoll and aard.whopoll.afk then return end if have_full_id(item) then return end autoid_q[#autoid_q + 1] = item -- deferred a tick: the {invitem} carrying the serial can land after "You get" tempTimer(1, function() local it = table.remove(autoid_q, 1) if not it then return end local serial = inv_serial[it:lower()] if serial then send("id " .. serial) end -- no serial means it's already gone end) end
--- -- identify / appraise box parser -- -- Aardwolf prints the same boxed table for 'id', 'appraise' and a shop appraise. -- Two things to watch: the mod blocks pack two "Label : +N" pairs per line and -- continue on unlabelled lines, and numbers carry commas (22,380). -- -- Nothing here sends a command — it reads boxes that already scrolled past. ---
local STAT_MAP = { ["Strength"] = "str", ["Intelligence"] = "intel", ["Wisdom"] = "wis", ["Dexterity"] = "dex", ["Constitution"] = "con", ["Luck"] = "luck", ["Hit points"] = "hp", ["Mana"] = "mana", ["Moves"] = "moves", ["Hit roll"] = "hit", ["Damage roll"] = "dam", ["All physical"] = "all_phys", ["All magic"] = "all_magic", ["Acid"] = "acid", ["Air"] = "air", ["Bash"] = "bash", ["Cold"] = "cold", ["Disease"] = "disease", ["Earth"] = "earth", ["Electric"] = "electric", ["Energy"] = "energy", ["Fire"] = "fire", ["Holy"] = "holy", ["Light"] = "light", ["Magic"] = "magic", ["Mental"] = "mental", ["Negative"] = "negative", ["Pierce"] = "pierce", ["Poison"] = "poison", ["Shadow"] = "shadow", ["Slash"] = "slash", ["Sonic"] = "sonic", ["Water"] = "water", }
local ID_FIELDS = { ["Keywords"] = "keywords", ["Type"] = "type", ["Worth"] = "worth", ["Weight"] = "weight", ["Level"] = "level", ["Score"] = "score", ["Wearable"] = "wearable", ["Material"] = "material", ["Flags"] = "flags", ["Found at"] = "found_at", ["Clan Item"] = "clan_item", ["Owned By"] = "owned_by", ["Leads to"] = "leads_to", ["Weapon Type"] = "weapon_type", ["Average Dam"] = "ave_dam", ["Specials"] = "specials", ["Inflicts"] = "inflicts", ["Damage Type"] = "dam_type", ["Capacity"] = "capacity", }
local idrec, id_mod_block local id_line_id, id_end_id
local function num(s) return tonumber((tostring(s or ""):gsub(",", ""))) end
local function id_mods(text) for label, sign, digits in text:gmatch("([A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]-)%s*:%s*([%+%-])(%d+)") do local col = STAT_MAP[U.trim(label)] if col then idrec[col] = tonumber(sign .. digits) end end end
local function id_store() local r = idrec idrec, id_mod_block = nil, nil if id_line_id then killTrigger(id_line_id); id_line_id = nil end if id_end_id then killTrigger(id_end_id); id_end_id = nil end if not r or not r.item or r.item == "" then return end
r.last_id = os.time() r.synced = 0 local found = db:fetch(T.item_stats, db:eq(T.item_stats.item, r.item)) if found and found[1] then db:update(T.item_stats, r, db:eq(T.item_stats.item, r.item)) else db:add(T.item_stats, r) end if CFG.idnote then U.ok("Loot Tracker: stats stored for " .. r.item) end end
local function on_id_line(body) if not idrec then return end
-- Name carries the item's colour local nm = body:match("^%s*Name%s+:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") if nm then idrec.item = U.trim(nm) idrec.item_color = color_of(idrec.item) id_mod_block = nil return end
-- Stat Mods / Resist Mods open a block that continues on unlabelled rows local mods = body:match("^%s*Stat Mods%s*:(.*)$") or body:match("^%s*Resist Mods%s*:(.*)$") if mods then id_mods(mods) id_mod_block = "stat" return end if id_mod_block and body:match("^%s+[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]-%s*:%s*[%+%-]%d") then id_mods(body) return end
-- Notes and Spells repeat; join rather than clobber local note = body:match("^%s*Notes%s+:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") if note and note ~= "" then idrec.notes = (idrec.notes and (idrec.notes .. "; ") or "") .. note id_mod_block = nil return end local sp = body:match("^%s*Spells%s+:%s*(.-)%s*|?%s*$") if sp and sp ~= "" then idrec.spells = (idrec.spells and (idrec.spells .. "; ") or "") .. sp id_mod_block = nil return end
-- plain "Label : value" pairs. Rows pack two of them ("Type : Weapon Level : 131"), -- so a value can't run to the next colon or it swallows the following label. Walk -- the colons: a label is the text since the last run of 2+ spaces (real labels use -- single spaces, column padding is always wider). local found, pos = {}, 1 while true do local c = body:find(":", pos, true) if not c then break end local pre = body:sub(1, c - 1):gsub("%s+$", "") local lstart, scan = 1, 1 while true do local a, b = pre:find("%s%s+", scan) if not a then break end lstart, scan = b + 1, b + 1 end found[#found + 1] = { label = U.trim(pre:sub(lstart)), lstart = lstart, vstart = c + 1 } pos = c + 1 end
local hit = false for i, p in ipairs(found) do local col = ID_FIELDS[p.label] if col then local vend = found[i + 1] and (found[i + 1].lstart - 1) or #body local v = U.trim((body:sub(p.vstart, vend):gsub("|%s*$", ""))) if v ~= "" then idrec[col] = LT.STAT_TEXT[col] and v or (num(v) or 0) hit = true end end end if hit then id_mod_block = nil end end
-- "| Keywords :" is the first row of every one of these boxes, so it opens the -- capture and arms the row + end triggers function LT.on_id_start(keywords) idrec = { full_id = 1, keywords = U.trim(keywords) } id_mod_block = nil
if id_line_id then killTrigger(id_line_id) end if id_end_id then killTrigger(id_end_id) end
id_line_id = tempRegexTrigger("^[|+](.*)$", function() on_id_line(matches[2] or "") end) -- the box ends at the first line that isn't part of it. Without the identify -- wish that line is the "full appraisal" nag, which is how we know the record -- is partial and worth re-identifying later. id_end_id = tempRegexTrigger("^[^|+].*$", function() if idrec and (matches[1] or ""):find("full appraisal", 1, true) then idrec.full_id = 0 end id_store() end) end
--- -- bulk appraise: "appraise 3-18" walks a shop's list numbers -- -- Paced one per second instead of fired in a burst — 20 commands at once is -- command spam and Aardwolf will treat it as such. Stops if you go AFK partway. ---
local APPRAISE_MAX, APPRAISE_WAIT = 60, 1 local appraise_q, appraise_n, appraise_gen = {}, 0, 0
local function appraise_tick(gen) if gen ~= appraise_gen then return end -- stale tick from an old run local n = table.remove(appraise_q, 1) if not n then U.ok("Loot Tracker: bulk appraise done (" .. appraise_n .. " sent).") return end if aard.whopoll and aard.whopoll.afk then U.warn("Loot Tracker: you're flagged AFK - bulk appraise stopped (" .. (#appraise_q + 1) .. " left).") appraise_q = {} return end appraise_n = appraise_n + 1 send("appraise " .. n) tempTimer(APPRAISE_WAIT, function() appraise_tick(gen) end) end
local function appraise_halt() local left = #appraise_q appraise_q = {} appraise_gen = appraise_gen + 1 -- orphans any tick already in flight return left end
function LT.bulk_appraise(a, b) local lo, hi = tonumber(a), tonumber(b) if not (lo and hi) then return end if lo > hi then lo, hi = hi, lo end if lo < 1 then lo = 1 end local count = hi - lo + 1 if count > APPRAISE_MAX then U.warn(string.format("Loot Tracker: %d items is over the %d cap - narrow the range.", count, APPRAISE_MAX)) return end appraise_halt() appraise_n = 0 for i = lo, hi do appraise_q[#appraise_q + 1] = i end U.note(string.format("Loot Tracker: appraising %d-%d (%d items, ~%ds). 'loot appraise stop' to halt.", lo, hi, count, count * APPRAISE_WAIT)) appraise_tick(appraise_gen) end
--- -- queries ---
-- Rows we captured store item_color as hex; rows migrated from MUSHclient store -- it as an @-coded string, and feeding one of those to cecho as a <tag> is -- garbage. Take whichever form we actually got. local function item_label(name, colour) colour = colour or "" if colour:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return "<" .. colour .. ">" .. name .. "<r>" elseif colour:find("@", 1, true) then return U.acolor(colour) .. "<r>" end return "<#7aa2f7>" .. name .. "<r>" end
local function count_of(sheet) local r = db:fetch(sheet) return r and #r or 0 end
local function like(sheet, col, term) return db:fetch(sheet, db:like(col, "%" .. term .. "%")) end
local function show_item(term) term = U.trim(term) if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot item <text>"); return end local rows = like(T.loot, T.loot.item, term) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No looted item matching '" .. term .. "'.") return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.item ~= b.item then return a.item < b.item end return (a.count or 0) > (b.count or 0) end) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do U.out("\n" .. item_label(r.item, r.item_color)) U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>from %s in %s - %s (%d) x%d<r>", r.mob, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?", r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?", r.roomid, r.count)) local s = db:fetch(T.item_stats, db:eq(T.item_stats.item, r.item)) if s and s[1] then local t = {} if s[1].type ~= "" then t[#t + 1] = s[1].type end if (s[1].level or 0) > 0 then t[#t + 1] = "L" .. s[1].level end if (s[1].score or 0) > 0 then t[#t + 1] = s[1].score .. " score" end if (s[1].worth or 0) > 0 then t[#t + 1] = s[1].worth .. "g" end if #t > 0 then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>" .. table.concat(t, " ") .. " ('loot stats' for the rest)<r>") end end end echo("\n") end
local function show_mob(term) term = U.trim(term) if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot mob <text>"); return end local rows = like(T.loot, T.loot.mob, term) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No mob drops matching '" .. term .. "'.") return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a.mob ~= b.mob then return a.mob < b.mob end return (a.count or 0) > (b.count or 0) end) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do U.out("\n<#7aa2f7>" .. r.mob .. "<r> <#8a93a8>(" .. (r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?") .. " - " .. (r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?") .. " " .. (r.roomid or 0) .. ")<r>") U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>drops %s x%d<r>", r.item, r.count)) end echo("\n") end
local STAT_ROW = { { "str", "Str" }, { "intel", "Int" }, { "wis", "Wis" }, { "dex", "Dex" }, { "con", "Con" }, { "luck", "Luck" }, { "hp", "Hp" }, { "mana", "Mana" }, { "moves", "Mv" }, { "hit", "Hit" }, { "dam", "Dam" }, } local RESIST_ROW = { { "all_phys", "AllPhys" }, { "all_magic", "AllMagic" }, { "acid", "Acid" }, { "air", "Air" }, { "bash", "Bash" }, { "cold", "Cold" }, { "disease", "Disease" }, { "earth", "Earth" }, { "electric", "Electric" }, { "energy", "Energy" }, { "fire", "Fire" }, { "holy", "Holy" }, { "light", "Light" }, { "magic", "Magic" }, { "mental", "Mental" }, { "negative", "Negative" }, { "pierce", "Pierce" }, { "poison", "Poison" }, { "shadow", "Shadow" }, { "slash", "Slash" }, { "sonic", "Sonic" }, { "water", "Water" }, }
local function mods_line(r, spec) local t = {} for _, p in ipairs(spec) do local v = tonumber(r[p[1]]) if v and v ~= 0 then t[#t + 1] = string.format("%s %+d", p[2], v) end end return table.concat(t, " ") end
local function show_stats(term) term = U.trim(term) if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot stats <text>"); return end local rows = like(T.item_stats, T.item_stats.item, term) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No item stats matching '" .. term .. "'. Appraise or id it first.") return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a.level or 0) > (b.level or 0) end) for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if i > 10 then break end U.out("\n" .. item_label(r.item, r.item_color)) local head = {} if r.type ~= "" then head[#head + 1] = r.type end if (r.level or 0) > 0 then head[#head + 1] = "L" .. r.level end if (r.score or 0) > 0 then head[#head + 1] = r.score .. " score" end if (r.worth or 0) > 0 then head[#head + 1] = r.worth .. "g" end if (r.weight or 0) > 0 then head[#head + 1] = r.weight .. " wt" end if #head > 0 then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. table.concat(head, " ") .. "<r>") end if r.wearable ~= "" then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>Worn : " .. r.wearable .. "<r>") end
local sm = mods_line(r, STAT_ROW) if sm ~= "" then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>Stats : " .. sm .. "<r>") end local rm = mods_line(r, RESIST_ROW) if rm ~= "" then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>Resist: " .. rm .. "<r>") end
if r.weapon_type ~= "" then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>Weapon: " .. r.weapon_type .. ((r.ave_dam or 0) > 0 and (" ave " .. r.ave_dam) or "") .. (r.specials ~= "" and (" [" .. r.specials .. "]") or "") .. "<r>") end if r.inflicts ~= "" then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>Infl : " .. r.inflicts .. (r.dam_type ~= "" and (" (" .. r.dam_type .. ")") or "") .. "<r>") end if r.spells ~= "" then U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>Spells: " .. r.spells .. "<r>") end if r.flags ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Flags : " .. r.flags .. "<r>") end if r.found_at ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Found : " .. r.found_at .. "<r>") end if r.keywords ~= "" then U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Keys : " .. r.keywords .. "<r>") end if r.full_id ~= 1 then U.out("\n <#e0af68>(partial - no identify wish when this was recorded)<r>") end end echo("\n") end
local function show_shop(term) term = U.trim(term) if term == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot shop <text>"); return end local rows = like(T.shop_stock, T.shop_stock.item, term) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No shop stock matching '" .. term .. "'.") return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a.price or 0) < (b.price or 0) end) for _, r in ipairs(rows) do U.out("\n" .. item_label(r.item, r.item_color)) U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>%s gold (lvl %d) @ %s - %s (%d)<r>", U.commas(r.price or 0), r.level or 0, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?", r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?", r.roomid)) end echo("\n") end
local function show_gathered(term) term = U.trim(term) local rows if term == "" then rows = db:fetch(T.gathered) else rows = db:fetch(T.gathered, db:OR( db:like(T.gathered.item, "%" .. term .. "%"), db:like(T.gathered.source, "%" .. term .. "%"))) end if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("No gathered items" .. (term ~= "" and (" matching '" .. term .. "'.") or " yet.")) return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a.count or 0) > (b.count or 0) end) for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if i > 40 then break end U.out("\n" .. item_label(r.item, r.item_color)) U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>from %s in %s - %s (%d) x%d<r>", r.source, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?", r.room ~= "" and r.room or "?", r.roomid, r.count)) end echo("\n") end
local function show_recent() local rows = db:fetch(T.loot) if not rows or #rows == 0 then U.note("Nothing recorded yet.") return end table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return (a.last_seen or 0) > (b.last_seen or 0) end) for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if i > 15 then break end U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>%-30s <#8a93a8><- %-24s (%s)<r>", r.item, r.mob, r.zone ~= "" and r.zone or "?")) end echo("\n") end
local function del_item(rest) rest = U.trim(rest) if rest == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot del <item> [roomid] (roomid scopes to that one room)") return end local item, roomid = rest, nil local id = rest:match("%s(%d+)$") -- trailing " <number>" = a room id if id then item = U.trim(rest:sub(1, #rest - #id)) roomid = tonumber(id) end
local total = 0 for _, pair in ipairs({ { T.loot, "loot" }, { T.shop_stock, "shop" }, { T.gathered, "gathered" } }) do local sheet, label = pair[1], pair[2] local where = db:like(sheet.item, "%" .. item .. "%") if roomid then where = db:AND(where, db:eq(sheet.roomid, roomid)) end local rows = db:fetch(sheet, where) local n = rows and #rows or 0 if n > 0 then db:delete(sheet, where) U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. label .. ": removed " .. n .. "<r>") total = total + n end end if total == 0 then U.note("No rows matching '" .. item .. "'" .. (roomid and (" in room " .. roomid) or "") .. ".") else U.ok("Deleted " .. total .. " row(s) matching '" .. item .. "'" .. (roomid and (" in room " .. roomid) or "") .. ".") end end
-- Retro-fix rows captured before variants were collapsed. Where the base name -- collides with an existing row the counts fold together and the variant goes. -- Touched rows go unsynced so the pool gets the corrected version. local function dedupe_variants() local renamed, merged = 0, 0 for _, spec in ipairs({ { sheet = T.loot, keys = { "mob" } }, { sheet = T.gathered, keys = { "source", "roomid" } }, }) do local rows = db:fetch(spec.sheet) or {} for _, r in ipairs(rows) do local clean = base_name(r.item, nil) if clean ~= "" and clean ~= r.item then local where = { db:eq(spec.sheet.item, clean) } for _, k in ipairs(spec.keys) do where[#where + 1] = db:eq(spec.sheet[k], r[k]) end local exists = db:fetch(spec.sheet, db:AND(unpack(where))) if exists and exists[1] then db:update(spec.sheet, { count = (exists[1].count or 0) + (r.count or 1), synced = 0 }, db:AND(unpack(where))) db:delete(spec.sheet, db:eq(spec.sheet._row_id, r._row_id)) merged = merged + 1 else db:update(spec.sheet, { item = clean, synced = 0 }, db:eq(spec.sheet._row_id, r._row_id)) renamed = renamed + 1 end end end end return renamed, merged end
--- -- share: export/import a JSON dump, and the pooled API ---
local SHARE_ORDER = { "loot", "shop_stock", "gathered", "item_stats" }
local function serialize_db() local data, rows = {}, 0 for _, name in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local arr = {} for _, r in ipairs(db:fetch(T[name]) or {}) do local o = {} for k, v in pairs(r) do if k ~= "_row_id" and k ~= "synced" then o[k] = v end end arr[#arr + 1] = o rows = rows + 1 end data[name] = arr end return yajl.to_string(data), rows end
-- from_pool matters for the sync flag. Rows pulled from the API are already in -- the pool, so they land synced and the next upload won't ship everyone else's -- data back. Rows from a clanmate's file land unsynced and get contributed. local function merge_dump(text, from_pool) local ok, data = pcall(yajl.to_value, tostring(text or "")) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end local flag = from_pool and 1 or 0 local added, seen = 0, 0 for _, name in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local sheet, arr = T[name], data[name] if type(arr) == "table" then for _, o in ipairs(arr) do if type(o) == "table" and o.item then o.synced = flag local ok2 = pcall(db.add, db, sheet, o) -- unique index rejects dupes if ok2 then added = added + 1 end seen = seen + 1 end end end end return added, seen end
local function pending_of(name) local r = db:fetch(T[name], db:eq(T[name].synced, 0)) return r and #r or 0 end
local function pending_all() local n = 0 for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do n = n + pending_of(t) end return n end
local function do_export(fn) fn = U.trim(fn) if fn == "" then fn = "SolaoLoot-share.json" end local path = U.datafile(fn) local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then U.err("Loot Tracker: can't write " .. path); return end local body, rows = serialize_db() f:write(body) f:close() U.ok("Loot Tracker: exported " .. rows .. " rows -> " .. path) U.note("Share that file out-of-band. Others: loot import " .. fn) end
local function do_import(fn) fn = U.trim(fn) if fn == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot import <file> (merge a shared export; existing rows kept)") return end local f = io.open(U.datafile(fn), "r") if not f then U.err("Loot Tracker: can't read " .. fn); return end local text = f:read("*a") f:close() local added, seen = merge_dump(text, false) U.ok("Loot Tracker: imported " .. fn .. " - " .. added .. " new row(s) (" .. seen .. " read).") end
--- -- commands ---
function LT.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" or verb == "status" then U.help("Loot Tracker", { { "loot rows", tostring(count_of(T.loot)) }, { "shop rows", tostring(count_of(T.shop_stock)) }, { "gathered", tostring(count_of(T.gathered)) }, { "id'd items", count_of(T.item_stats) .. " (auto-id " .. (CFG.autoid and "on" or "off") .. ")" }, { "to sync", tostring(pending_all()) }, })
elseif verb == "item" then show_item(rest) elseif verb == "mob" then show_mob(rest) elseif verb == "shop" then show_shop(rest) elseif verb == "stats" or verb == "stat" then show_stats(rest) elseif verb == "gathered" or verb == "gather" then show_gathered(rest) elseif verb == "recent" then show_recent() elseif verb == "del" or verb == "forget" or verb == "remove" then del_item(rest)
elseif verb == "id" then local kw = U.trim(rest) if kw == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot id <keyword> (or 'loot autoid on|off')"); return end send("id " .. kw)
elseif verb == "here" or verb == "ground" then local kw = U.trim(rest) if kw == "" then U.warn("Usage: loot here <keyword> (picks it up and records the room spawn)") return end here_arm() send("get " .. kw)
elseif verb == "autoid" then local s = U.trim(rest):lower() if s == "on" then CFG.autoid = true; save() U.ok("Loot Tracker: auto-identify on loot is ON. Needs the identify wish for full stats.") elseif s == "off" then CFG.autoid = false; save() U.ok("Loot Tracker: auto-identify on loot is off.") else U.note("Loot Tracker: auto-identify is " .. (CFG.autoid and "ON" or "off") .. ". 'loot autoid on|off'") U.note("Appraise and manual 'id' are always captured - this only controls sending 'id' for you.") end
elseif verb == "idnote" then local s = U.trim(rest):lower() if s == "on" then CFG.idnote = true; save(); U.ok("Loot Tracker: will confirm each stat capture.") elseif s == "off" then CFG.idnote = false; save(); U.ok("Loot Tracker: stat captures are silent now.") else U.note("Loot Tracker: stat-capture notices are " .. (CFG.idnote and "on" or "off") .. ".") end
elseif verb == "bags" then local sub, w = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") sub, w = (sub or ""):lower(), U.trim(w or ""):lower() if sub == "add" and w ~= "" then exclude[w] = true; CFG.bags = set_csv(exclude); save() U.ok("Ignoring gather sources matching '" .. w .. "'.") elseif sub == "del" and w ~= "" then exclude[w] = nil; CFG.bags = set_csv(exclude); save() U.ok("No longer ignoring '" .. w .. "'.") else local carried = {} for x in pairs(my_bags) do carried[#carried + 1] = x end table.sort(carried) U.note("Containers you carry (from invdata, rename-proof):") U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. (#carried > 0 and table.concat(carried, ", ") or "(none seen yet - type 'inv')") .. "<r>") U.note("Fallback word-list (source containing any = ignored):") U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. set_csv(exclude):gsub(",", ", ") .. "<r>") U.out("\n <#8a93a8>loot bags add <word> | loot bags del <word><r>\n") end
elseif verb == "flags" then local sub, w = rest:match("^(%S*)%s*(.*)$") sub, w = (sub or ""):lower(), U.trim(w or ""):lower():gsub("[%(%)]", "") if sub == "add" and w ~= "" then bonus_flags[w] = true; CFG.flags = set_csv(bonus_flags); save() U.ok("Loot Tracker: '" .. w .. "' is a bonus flag.") elseif sub == "del" and w ~= "" then bonus_flags[w] = nil; CFG.flags = set_csv(bonus_flags); save() U.ok("Loot Tracker: '" .. w .. "' is no longer treated as a bonus flag.") else U.note("Bonus-loot flags stripped from loot/gathered names:") U.out("\n <#c8d0dc>" .. set_csv(bonus_flags):gsub(",", ", ") .. "<r>") U.out("\n <#8a93a8>Only stripped when the bracket colour matches a bonus tier.<r>\n") end
elseif verb == "appraise" then local sub = U.trim(rest):lower() local lo, hi = sub:match("^(%d+)%s*%-%s*(%d+)$") if sub == "stop" then local left = appraise_halt() if left > 0 then U.warn("Loot Tracker: bulk appraise stopped, " .. left .. " unsent.") else U.note("Loot Tracker: bulk appraise wasn't running.") end elseif lo then LT.bulk_appraise(lo, hi) else U.warn("Usage: appraise <first>-<last> (e.g. appraise 1-12) | loot appraise stop") end
elseif verb == "dedupe" then local renamed, merged = dedupe_variants() if renamed + merged == 0 then U.ok("Loot Tracker: nothing to collapse - no variant rows found.") else U.ok(string.format("Loot Tracker: collapsed %d variant row(s) - %d renamed, %d merged.", renamed + merged, renamed, merged)) end
elseif verb == "export" then do_export(rest) elseif verb == "import" then do_import(rest)
elseif verb == "api" then U.help("Loot Tracker pool", { { "endpoint", API_URL }, { "auth", CFG.authkey ~= "" and ("yes, as " .. (CFG.authname ~= "" and CFG.authname or "?")) or "no - run 'loot auth'" }, { "loot", pending_of("loot") .. " of " .. count_of(T.loot) .. " to sync" }, { "shop_stock", pending_of("shop_stock") .. " of " .. count_of(T.shop_stock) .. " to sync" }, { "gathered", pending_of("gathered") .. " of " .. count_of(T.gathered) .. " to sync" }, { "item_stats", pending_of("item_stats") .. " of " .. count_of(T.item_stats) .. " to sync" }, })
elseif verb == "auth" then LT.auth() elseif verb == "upload" then LT.upload(U.trim(rest):lower() == "full") elseif verb == "update" then LT.update()
elseif verb == "resync" then if U.trim(rest):lower() ~= "yes" then U.note("'loot resync yes' re-sends everything on the next upload.") else for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do db:update(T[t], { synced = 0 }) end U.ok("Loot Tracker: all rows marked unsynced - 'loot upload' will re-send everything.") end
elseif verb == "clear" then local what = U.trim(rest):lower() local map = { loot = T.loot, shop = T.shop_stock, gathered = T.gathered, stats = T.item_stats } if map[what] then db:delete(map[what], db:gt(map[what]._row_id, -1)) U.ok(what .. " table cleared.") else U.warn("Type 'loot clear loot|shop|gathered|stats'.") end
else U.help("Loot Tracker", { { "loot", "row counts" }, { "loot item <text>", "where an item drops from (mob / zone / room)" }, { "loot mob <text>", "what a mob drops" }, { "loot shop <text>", "which shops natively stock an item" }, { "loot gathered <text>", "where a room resource is picked up" }, { "loot stats <text>", "stat block for an item" }, { "loot id <keyword>", "identify an item and store its stats" }, { "loot autoid on|off", "auto-identify freshly looted gear" }, { "loot idnote on|off", "confirm each stat capture on screen" }, { "loot here <keyword>", "get a room-floor spawn and record it" }, { "loot del <item> [roomid]", "remove matching rows" }, { "loot bags [add|del <word>]", "container words ignored for gathers" }, { "loot flags [add|del <word>]", "bonus-loot flags stripped from names" }, { "loot dedupe", "collapse variant rows already captured" }, { "appraise <a>-<b>", "appraise a range of shop list numbers, paced" }, { "loot appraise stop", "halt a running bulk appraise" }, { "loot recent", "last 15 things looted" }, { "loot export [file]", "dump the DB to a file to share" }, { "loot import <file>", "merge a shared export" }, { "loot api | auth | upload | update | resync yes", "" }, { "loot clear loot|shop|gathered|stats", "wipe a table" }, }) end end
--- -- boot ---
aard.register("loot", "item/mob/shop provenance database", LT.cmd)

Script.name: loottracker/api
Script.script:
--[[ Loot Tracker — shared pool sync Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
MUSHclient used async.doAsyncRemoteRequest with a status code in the callback. Mudlet gives us postHTTP/getHTTP plus sys*HttpDone / sys*HttpError events, and the error path doesn't hand back a status. So the 401 rule becomes: if a request fails while we hold a key, re-auth ONCE and retry ONCE.
That single-retry cap is the important part. Every /auth mints a NEW account (the name can come back with a -2 suffix), so careless re-registration would fragment one player across many accounts. ]]
aard = aard or {} aard.loot = aard.loot or {}
local LT = aard.loot local U = aard.util local T = LT.t
local API_URL = "https://api.aardwolf.muds.fyi" local SHARE_ORDER = { "loot", "shop_stock", "gathered", "item_stats" }
-- Upload in slices capped by BYTES, not row count. The MUSHclient version learned -- the hard way that a ~144KB body never arrived: past roughly one socket buffer -- fewer bytes reach the wire than content-length advertises. A row cap alone -- wouldn't do it either - one item with a long notes field could blow the budget. local MAX_BODY = 32768 local UPLOAD_READ = 200 local FULL_EVERY = 7 * 86400 -- re-declare the whole DB weekly
local CFG -- lazily bound to the same table init.lua persists local pending = {} -- url -> handler, so the event handlers can find their caller
local function cfg() if not CFG then CFG = U.load("loottracker", {}) end return CFG end
local function save() U.save("loottracker", cfg()) end
local function key() return U.trim(cfg().authkey or "") end
--- -- request plumbing ---
local function handle_done(event, url, body) local h = pending[url] if not h then return end pending[url] = nil h.ok(body) end
local function handle_err(event, a, b) -- sysPostHttpError(response, url) / sysGetHttpError(response, url) local url = b or a local h = pending[url] if not h then return end pending[url] = nil h.fail(a) end
if aard_loot_http_handlers then for _, id in ipairs(aard_loot_http_handlers) do U.killhandler(id) end end aard_loot_http_handlers = { registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpDone", handle_done), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", handle_done), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpError", handle_err), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpError", handle_err), }
local function post(url, body, headers, ok, fail) pending[url] = { ok = ok, fail = fail } postHTTP(body, url, headers) end
local function get(url, headers, ok, fail) pending[url] = { ok = ok, fail = fail } getHTTP(url, headers) end
--- -- auth ---
-- POST /auth for `name`; store the key AND the name the server hands back (it may -- add a -N suffix if the name is taken). local function register(name, cb) local body = yajl.to_string({ name = name }) post(API_URL .. "/auth", body, { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" }, function(page) local ok, t = pcall(yajl.to_value, tostring(page or "")) if ok and type(t) == "table" and t.key and U.trim(t.key) ~= "" then cfg().authkey = U.trim(t.key) -- hidden; never displayed cfg().authname = U.trim(t.name or name) save() if cb then cb(true) end else U.warn("Loot Tracker: auth failed - no key in the reply.") if cb then cb(false) end end end, function(err) U.warn("Loot Tracker: auth failed (" .. tostring(err) .. ").") if cb then cb(false) end end) end
function LT.auth() if key() ~= "" then U.ok("Loot Tracker: already authenticated as " .. (cfg().authname or "?") .. ".") return end local name = U.charname() if not name or name == "" then U.warn("Loot Tracker: no character name yet - log in first, then 'loot auth'.") return end U.note("Loot Tracker: registering '" .. name .. "'...") register(name, function(ok) if ok then U.ok("Loot Tracker: authenticated as " .. (cfg().authname or name) .. ". 'loot upload' / 'loot update' are ready.") end end) end
-- request against /loot; one re-auth + one retry on failure, then give up local function loot_request(method, body, on_ok, retried) local url = API_URL .. "/loot" local headers = { ["x-api-key"] = key() } if body then headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json" end
local function fail(err) if not retried and key() ~= "" then local name = U.charname() if not name or name == "" then U.warn("Loot Tracker: request failed and no character name to re-auth with.") return end cfg().authkey = "" -- discard the possibly-dead key first save() U.note("Loot Tracker: request rejected, re-registering '" .. name .. "'...") register(name, function(ok) if ok then loot_request(method, body, on_ok, true) else U.warn("Loot Tracker: sync aborted - couldn't get a valid key.") end end) else U.warn("Loot Tracker: sync failed (" .. tostring(err) .. "). Run it again to resume.") end end
if method == "POST" then post(url, body, headers, on_ok, fail) else get(url, headers, on_ok, fail) end end
--- -- upload ---
local function row_out(r) local o = {} for k, v in pairs(r) do if k ~= "_row_id" and k ~= "synced" then o[k] = v end end return o end
local function pending_of(name) local r = db:fetch(T[name], db:eq(T[name].synced, 0)) return r and #r or 0 end
local function pending_all() local n = 0 for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do n = n + pending_of(t) end return n end
-- The next unsynced slice of `name`, taking as many rows as fit in MAX_BODY. -- A sent row gets marked synced so it drops out of the next query - that's what -- makes a half-finished upload resume exactly where it stopped. local function serialize_slice(name) local rows = db:fetch(T[name], db:eq(T[name].synced, 0)) or {} local parts, ids, bytes = {}, {}, 0 for i, r in ipairs(rows) do if i > UPLOAD_READ then break end local enc = yajl.to_string(row_out(r)) -- always take at least one row, even if that row is enormous on its own if #ids > 0 and (bytes + #enc) > MAX_BODY then break end parts[#parts + 1] = enc ids[#ids + 1] = r._row_id bytes = bytes + #enc + 1 end if #ids == 0 then return nil, nil end return '{"' .. name .. '":[' .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. ']}', ids end
local function mark_synced(name, ids) for _, id in ipairs(ids) do db:update(T[name], { synced = 1 }, db:eq(T[name]._row_id, id)) end end
function LT.upload(force_full) if key() == "" then U.warn("Loot Tracker: not authenticated - run 'loot auth' first.") return end
-- Deltas are cheap but they only declare what changed, and the pool's -- "how many players have this item" counter learns from what you declare. -- Skip that forever and you never register on items you already share with -- everyone. So re-declare the whole DB on a slow cadence, deltas in between. local full = force_full or (os.time() - (tonumber(cfg().lastfull) or 0)) >= FULL_EVERY if full then for _, t in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do db:update(T[t], { synced = 0 }) end end
local grand = pending_all() if grand == 0 then U.note("Loot Tracker: nothing new to upload - the pool already has everything here.") return end U.note("Loot Tracker: uploading " .. grand .. (full and " rows (full re-declare)" or " new/changed rows") .. "...")
local ti, sent, batch = 1, 0, 0 local function step() while ti <= #SHARE_ORDER and pending_of(SHARE_ORDER[ti]) == 0 do ti = ti + 1 end if ti > #SHARE_ORDER then -- only stamp a full declare once it actually finished, so an aborted -- one gets retried rather than counting as this week's if full then cfg().lastfull = os.time(); save() end U.ok(string.format("Loot Tracker: upload ok - %d rows in %d batches.%s", sent, batch, full and " (full re-declare)" or "")) return end
local name = SHARE_ORDER[ti] local body, ids = serialize_slice(name) if not body then ti = ti + 1; step(); return end batch = batch + 1 local n = #ids loot_request("POST", body, function() mark_synced(name, ids) -- only after the server confirms it sent = sent + n U.note(string.format("Loot Tracker: %s +%d (%d/%d)", name, n, sent, grand)) step() end) end step() end
function LT.update() if key() == "" then U.warn("Loot Tracker: not authenticated - run 'loot auth' first.") return end U.note("Loot Tracker: fetching the shared pool...") loot_request("GET", nil, function(page) local ok, data = pcall(yajl.to_value, tostring(page or "")) if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then U.warn("Loot Tracker: update failed - couldn't parse the reply.") return end local added, seen = 0, 0 for _, name in ipairs(SHARE_ORDER) do local arr = data[name] if type(arr) == "table" then for _, o in ipairs(arr) do if type(o) == "table" and o.item then o.synced = 1 -- came from the pool; don't ship it back if pcall(db.add, db, T[name], o) then added = added + 1 end seen = seen + 1 end end end end U.ok("Loot Tracker: update ok - " .. added .. " new row(s) (" .. seen .. " read).") end) end
